name: saloonphp/xml-wrangler
input_api: XmlReader::fromString(string) then elements() (documented; returns Element DTOs keyed by element name); fromFile(path) and fromStream(resource) are cross-checked for the same summary
parser_family: libxml2 via PHP ext/xmlreader (veewee/xml Reader) and ext/dom DOMDocument::loadXML (veewee/xml xml_decode); shared with the standard libxml2 APIs, sabre/xml and symfony/dom-crawler
package_own_scope: XmlReader matcher/query layer over veewee/xml and the Element DTO mapping: elements() matches the document element in a veewee Reader pull loop, takes its readOuterXml() string and decodes it with veewee xml_decode into nested arrays (raw qualified-name keys, same-name children grouped into lists, @attributes, @namespaces with non-empty URIs, leaf textContent), then converts those arrays into Element objects with namespaces folded into xmlns/xmlns:* attributes. Tokenizing, well-formedness, entity and CDATA decoding and namespace binding are libxml2.
oracle: projects/xml/php/saloon_xml_wrangler/oracle.py (Python expat without namespace processing: raw qualified names, non-declaration attributes in document order, declarations with a non-empty URI sorted per element, untrimmed text of elements without child elements)
family: libxml2 via PHP XMLReader and DOMDocument, shared with the standard path, sabre/xml and symfony/dom-crawler

popularity.caveat: Cumulative package downloads are a package adoption proxy, not XML parse counts; the package also ships an XmlWriter, and many installs come through Saloon HTTP integrations. It shares the libxml2 parser family with the standard path, sabre/xml and symfony/dom-crawler.

caveats: Raw-name scope: element and attribute names are raw qualified names (prefix:local). The package exposes no namespace URI per element; declarations appear only as xmlns/xmlns:* attributes on the declaring element. The summary does not infer URIs.

veewee/xml's namespaces() builder drops declarations whose URI is empty, so <plain xmlns=""> in order-default-ns.xml carries no attribute and is indistinguishable from an element in the inherited default namespace. Recorded as package behavior, not repaired; the oracle scope excludes undeclarations.
The package does not keep the source order of namespace declarations; the summary sorts them per element by attribute name.
Same-name children are grouped into one list under their first occurrence, so non-adjacent same-name siblings would be reordered; in both controls the grouped order equals document order.
Text beside child elements (mixed content), comments, processing instructions and the XML declaration are not exposed. Leaf content is DOM textContent, untrimmed.

libxml2 parses each input twice: XMLReader reads the original bytes, then DOMDocument::loadXML parses the readOuterXml() serialization of the root element. Only valid controls were run; no malformed, vulnerability or resource inputs.

AFL++ feedback comes from a native overlay that runs the same harness on PHP 8.5.12 and libxml2 2.15.4, with only libxml2 parser.c, parserInternals.c, SAX2.c, xmlreader.c and PHP ext/xmlreader/php_xmlreader.c and ext/dom/document.c instrumented. Both controls give stable maps over 5 repeats (1,889 and 2,053 tuples) and differ in 414 tuples; 368 already differ when the veewee/xml Reader pass runs alone over the original bytes, and elements() alone gives the same maps as the full harness. The family is shared, so these tuples are libxml2/PHP-extension feedback, not package-owned feedback. Xdebug covers 56 XML Wrangler lines (XmlReader.php 33) and 298 veewee/xml lines on catalog-ns.xml and is kept separate.
